newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish shares edge up to new record, more to come.
newsitem.headline: Danish shares edge up to new record, more to come.

text.p: The Danish top-20 KFX share index closed at yet another record high on Tuesday and dealers saw no reason for the trend not to continue.

"If Wall Street performs more or less alright tonight, we could well continue upwards again tomorrow. The market is pretty active considering we are in the silly season with many players on summer holiday," one dealer said.

The KFX top-20 index closed 0.76 point up at 179.01, an all-time closing high for the sixth time this month and the 40th time this year. The KFX August future fell 0.15 point to 179.00 with 60 contracts each worth 100,000 crowns traded.

Bucking the upward trend and preventing the index from climbing to even greater heights was Sophus Berendsen which shed 35 crowns or 3.5 percent to finish at 965, hit by falls in London for its partly-owned Rentokil unit.
Insurance paper continued to make advances with Tryg-Baltica putting on 14 crowns to finish at 399 and Topdanmark climbing 11 to 896 crowns.
SAS, Moeller, Tele Danmark and Den Danske Bank also helped the index up. --Chris Follett, Copenhagen newsroom +45-33969652
